en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a bridge over a river in a European city. In the foreground is an ornate metal bridge with stone pillars and railings; pedestrians walk along the cobbled embankment. Across the river stand historic buildings with gabled roofs and a church tower with a bulbous dome. In the background a wooded hill with a fortress and a prominent clock tower rises above the town. Printed text at the top identifies the scene.
